---
title: "Bayesian Cox frailty model: basic run"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(rstan)
library(survival)
options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())
rstan_options(auto_write = TRUE)
```

# Data

The `kidney` dataset from `survival`. The Stan model assumes rows are sorted by ascending time.

```{r data}
k <- survival::kidney
k <- k[order(k$time), ]

# Covariates exactly as in the paper: age in years, sex coded 1 = male, 2 = female,
# 0/1 indicators for disease types GN, AN, PKD (Other is the baseline).
X <- cbind(age = k$age,
           sex = k$sex,
           GN  = as.integer(k$disease == "GN"),
           AN  = as.integer(k$disease == "AN"),
           PKD = as.integer(k$disease == "PKD"))

stan_data <- list(N   = nrow(k),
                  M   = length(unique(k$id)),
                  P   = ncol(X),
                  t   = k$time,
                  C   = k$status,
                  pid = k$id,
                  X   = X,
                  sigma = 1)
```

# Sampling

## Fit

```{r fit_sampling, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results="hide"}
fit <- stan(file = "../stan/frailty_cox_replication.stan",
            data = stan_data,
            seed = 1,
            chains = 4,
            iter = 50000,
            thin = 4,
            refresh = 0)
```

## Results

```{r summary}
print(fit, pars = c("beta"), probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))
```
Paper values for comparison (McGilchrist & Aisbett 1991, Table 2): age 0.0063, sex -1.7947, GN 0.2062, AN 0.4099, PKD -1.2961, sigma^2 0.3821.


## Comparison with McGilchrist & Aisbett (1991)

Regression estimates and SEs are transcribed from the paper into `data/paper_table2.csv`. The paper's patient frailties (Table 1) ship with the `kidney` dataset as the `frail` column, so they are read from there.

```{r compare-coefs}
paper <- read.csv("../data/paper_table2.csv")

s <- summary(fit, pars = c("beta", "sigma2"), probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))$summary
stan_res <- data.frame(parameter = paper$parameter,
                       stan_mean   = s[, "mean"],
                       stan_sd     = s[, "sd"],
                       stan_median = s[, "50%"],
                       rhat        = s[, "Rhat"],
                       n_eff       = s[, "n_eff"],
                       row.names = NULL)

comp <- merge(paper, stan_res, by = "parameter", sort = FALSE)
comp <- comp[match(paper$parameter, comp$parameter), ]
comp$diff <- comp$stan_mean - comp$estimate

comp
```

```{r compare-frailties, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
frail_paper <- unique(k[, c("id", "frail")])
frail_paper <- frail_paper[order(frail_paper$id), ]

Zs <- summary(fit, pars = "Z", probs = 0.5)$summary
frail <- data.frame(patient  = frail_paper$id,
                    Z_paper  = frail_paper$frail,
                    Z_stan   = Zs[, "50%"],
                    rhat     = Zs[, "Rhat"],
                    row.names = NULL)
frail$diff <- frail$Z_stan - frail$Z_paper

plot(frail$Z_paper, frail$Z_stan, pch = 19,
     xlab = "Paper Z (Table 1)", ylab = "Stan posterior median Z",
     xlim = c(0, 3.2), ylim = c(0, 3.2))
abline(0, 1, lty = 2)

round(cor(frail$Z_paper, frail$Z_stan), 3)

frail
```
## Diagnostics 

```{r diagnostics}
traceplot(fit, pars = c("beta"))
rstan::get_num_divergent(fit)
```

# Optimizer

## Fit

```{r fit_optimizing, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results="hide"}
# Used for the MAP
mode <- optimizing(stan_model("../stan/frailty_cox_replication.stan"),
                   data = stan_data,
                   seed = 1,
                   as_vector = FALSE,
                   hessian = TRUE,
                   draws = 10000,
                   importance_resampling = TRUE,
                   algorithm='Newton')
```

## Results


```{r summary - optimizer, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results="hide"}
paper <- read.csv("../data/paper_table2.csv")

map <- data.frame(parameter = paper$parameter,
                  paper     = paper$estimate,
                  MAP       = c(mode$par$beta, mode$par$sigma2))
map$diff <- map$MAP - map$paper

print(map)
```

```{r compare-frailties-optimizer, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
frail_paper <- unique(k[, c("id", "frail")])
frail_paper <- frail_paper[order(frail_paper$id), ]

frail <- data.frame(patient  = frail_paper$id,
                    Z_paper  = frail_paper$frail,
                    Z_stan   = mode$par$Z,
                    row.names = NULL)
frail$diff <- frail$Z_stan - frail$Z_paper

plot(frail$Z_paper, frail$Z_stan, pch = 19,
     xlab = "Paper Z (Table 1)", ylab = "Stan posterior mode Z",
     xlim = c(0, 3.2), ylim = c(0, 3.2))
abline(0, 1, lty = 2)

round(cor(frail$Z_paper, frail$Z_stan), 3)

frail
```

## Diagonstics
```{r diagnostics - optimizer}
mode$return_code # 0 indicates successful convergence
ev <- eigen(mode$hessian, symmetric = TRUE)$values
all(ev < -1e-8) #TRUE -identifies a Strict local maximum

```
